 Al-Hilal Saudi FC has a clear advantage over Al-Qadisiyah FC in their last ten encounters. They have secured six victories, while Al-Qadisiyah FC have claimed two, with two matches ending in draws. This suggests that Al-Hilal historically have the upper hand in this fixture.
 However, more recent meetings have shown a more competitive trend, indicating that the gap between the teams is narrowing. The last two games between the teams both ended in exciting 2-2 draws, demonstrating Al-Qadisiyah’s ability to challenge their opponents. The Al-Qadisiyah FC vs. Al-Hilal Saudi FC match has certainly been entertaining recently.
 Home advantage also plays a significant role when these clubs clash. In their last four meetings, neither team lost when playing in front of their home supporters. This suggests that playing at home offers a considerable boost, which could be crucial in the upcoming game.

 Recent form
 Al-Qadisiyah FC are currently leading the way in the Saudi Pro League , sitting at the top of the table. The team is enjoying a fantastic run of form, having won 15 of their last 21 matches in all competitions. This impressive consistency demonstrates their strength and ambition for the season.
 Their away form has been perfect, with five wins from five and only one goal conceded. While their overall consistency keeps them at the top of the table, they have shown some vulnerability at home, dropping points twice and conceding eight goals. This slight discrepancy in their home performances could be a decisive factor in the upcoming fixture.

 Al-Hilal Saudi FC - Enjoying a fantastic run
 Let’s analyse Al-Hilal Saudi FC’s current run. We will examine the team’s momentum, their recent results and the main men for this trip.
 Recent form
 Al-Hilal Saudi FC are also enjoying a formidable season, comfortably sitting in second place in the Saudi Pro League. They have won 16 of their last 21 matches, and their recent form has been outstanding. The team is currently on a five-match winning streak in both domestic and AFC Champions League fixtures.
 They have won all four of their away league games, making their performance on the road perfect. In these matches, they have scored an impressive 16 goals while conceding only once, showcasing both a clinical attack and a rock-solid defence. Key players such as Ollie Watkins and Gabriel Martinelli have played a crucial role in their success.
 Adding to their strength, Al-Hilal will enter this game with a fully available squad, with no reported injuries. This gives them a full range of options to deploy against Al-Qadisiyah FC. Their potent attack, combined with defensive stability when playing away, makes them a formidable opponent.

 With strikers like M. Retegui for the hosts and Ollie Watkins for the visitors, goals seem very likely. Therefore, a bet on “Al-Hilal Saudi FC to win or draw and over 2.5 goals in total” is plausible.
 Considering both sides are on long winning streaks, a draw appears unlikely in this fixture. Our main prediction is for a decisive result with plenty of goals, backing either team to win and over 2.5 goals .
